sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A solitary palm of humid Neotropical forests, reaching about 25 m. Its trunk stands on a cone of stilt roots up to 3 m tall; the pinnate leaves reach 3–4.5 m.

sections.title: Inflorescences and fruit
sections.text: The pendulous inflorescence may reach about 2 m. Ripe drupes are described as yellow-green, spherical and about 2–3 cm across. Some sources report the mesocarp as food.

sections.title: Plate and edibility
sections.text: The catalogue plate shows blue-black fruit, unlike the yellow-green colour described in the sources, so it is not displayed. The reported food use concerns the fruit mesocarp and does not establish that other parts are safe.
